item.description: PURCHASE ORDER TRACKER SPREADSHEET + RECEIVING LOG | Excel & Google Sheets | Instant Download A simple order tracker for small businesses: every purchase order in one place, with late, due-soon and backordered POs flagged automatically, so you always know what's open and what still hasn't arrived.

item.title: Inventory Tracker Spreadsheet with Reorder Alerts
item.description: INVENTORY TRACKER SPREADSHEET WITH REORDER ALERTS | Inventory Forecast + PO Tracker | Excel & Google Sheets | Instant Download Know exactly when to reorder. For every item, this inventory tracker shows how many days of stock you have left, the date you'll run out, the date you need to order by, and how much to order.

item.title: Reorder Point Calculator
item.description: STOP GUESSING WHEN TO REORDER. This calculator uses the real industry-standard combined-variability safety stock formula - the same method used in professional inventory planning - not just a flat multiplier. It accounts for BOTH how much your demand swings day to day AND how unreliable your vendor's lead time is, so your safety stock number actually reflects your real risk.

item.title: Supplier Tracker Spreadsheet
item.description: KNOW WHICH VENDORS ACTUALLY DELIVER ON TIME - BEFORE IT COSTS YOU. Log every PO's promised vs. actual delivery, and this tracker automatically scores each vendor: on-time percentage, fill rate, average lead time, and lead time consistency. No more relying on gut feel about which supplier is reliable.

item.title: Purchasing SOP Templates
item.description: 6 editable purchasing and inventory SOPs (standard operating procedures) for small business: placing purchase orders, receiving procedures, approval thresholds, vendor price changes, backup vendors and month-end review. STOP REINVENTING YOUR PURCHASING PROCESS EVERY TIME SOMETHING GOES WRONG.

item.title: Supplier Price Tracker
item.description: NEVER GET BLINDSIDED BY A PRICE INCREASE AGAIN. Every time a vendor sends a new price, log it as one row. This sheet automatically finds that item's previous price and calculates the dollar and percent change - and flags any increase of 5% or more so nothing slips past you unnoticed.

item.title: Purchase Order Approval Tracker
item.description: KNOW WHO NEEDS TO APPROVE A PO BEFORE IT GOES OUT - AND KNOW BEFORE YOU'RE OVER YOUR CREDIT LIMIT. This sheet does two jobs most businesses track separately: it automatically routes each PO to the right approver based on dollar amount, and it tracks each vendor's credit limit exposure so you never get caught over-extended.

item.title: Inventory Count Sheet
item.description: CATCH SHRINKAGE AND RECEIVING ERRORS BEFORE THEY BECOME A BIG WRITE-OFF. Built for cycle counting - counting a rotating subset of inventory regularly instead of one giant annual count. Automatically calculates the variance between what your system says you have and what you actually counted, and flags anything outside your tolerance so you investigate the right items.

item.title: Ingredient Cost Comparison Sheet
item.description: COMPARE VENDORS FOR THE SAME INGREDIENT WITHOUT DOING THE MATH BY HAND. Log multiple vendors' specs for the same ingredient side by side - even when they sell different package sizes. This sheet automatically calculates price-per-unit so you're comparing apples to apples, and the dashboard finds the cheapest vendor per ingredient automatically.

item.title: Vendor Onboarding Checklist
item.description: DON'T FIND OUT A NEW VENDOR IS UNRELIABLE AFTER YOU'VE ALREADY PAID THEM. A complete, stage-by-stage checklist for bringing on a new supplier - from before you commit, through account setup, through the first order, to ongoing relationship review. Includes a red-flags list of warning signs that should pause onboarding entirely.
